description: This file defines the ShareeListAdapterListener interface for the Nextcloud Notes Android client, specifying methods related to sharing functionalities such as copying links, showing sharing menus, and managing permissions.

classes.name: ShareeListAdapterListener
classes.description: Interface for handling sharing-related actions in the notes app, including link copying, sharing menu display, permission dialogs, and profile display.

methods.name: showSharingMenuActionSheet
methods.description: Displays the sharing options menu for the given OCShare.

methods.name: copyInternalLink
methods.description: Copies an internal link within the app.

methods.name: createPublicShareLink
methods.description: Creates a new public share link.

methods.name: createSecureFileDrop
methods.description: Creates a secure file drop for sharing.

methods.name: requestPasswordForShare
methods.description: Requests a password for the specified share, with an option to ask for a password.

methods.name: showPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to modify or view share permissions.

methods.name: showProfileBottomSheet
methods.description: Displays the profile bottom sheet for the specified account and share recipient.
